notes.title: Big update + Sale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! A big update has been pushed for Save Me, Sakuya-san! And to coincide with this update, a discount for this game and all of my other games will commence! 

The main features of the update are as follows: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40561527/3cfcd1b5bc6af0dfb62bdc5af9e9fd686b915197.png[/img]

[b][list]
[*] The game now plays at a much higher resolution! 
[*]  The crashing and freezing problems have been fixed! The game should not crash, freeze or hang up anymore! 
[*] Some small missing dialogue that didn't play due to a bug have been fixed
[*] A proper credits screen in-game! You can check out a neatly formatted credits list of all the songs and some assets used from the title screen 
[*] A cute little splash screen will show up when you launch the game!
[/list] [/b]

If for whatever reason, you want to go back to the older version of the game, enter the code "olddinosaur21" in the beta tab of the game and you will be granted access to the older version.

Once again I'd like to remind you that Save Me, Sakuya-San and all my other games are ON SALE RIGHT NOW! So pick them up or gift them to a friend! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639610/Save_Me_Sakuyasan/

I also have an upcoming game you're free to check out too! It's a 3D turn based JRPG with a heart throbbing story and a awesome soundtrack! Wish list it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1753050/My_Inner_Darkness_Is_A_Hot_Anime_Girl/
